10.title: Badge Constructor: store data on each instance
10.description: Create a `Badge` class with an initializer that stores its label and color. Add a `summary` method returning `label: color`, then create one badge and print its summary.
10.learningObjective: Use self in __init__ to store instance-specific label and color values.
instructions: Assign both arguments to attributes on `self`.
Add `summary(self)` and return the formatted label and color.

workedExample.explanation: The initializer runs when an instance is created. Assigning through self stores values per object, while a method can read those attributes later.

10.hint: Use `self.label = label` and `self.color = color` to keep values on this instance.
10.explanation: The initializer runs when an instance is created. Assigning through self stores values per object, while a method can read those attributes later.

testCases.description: Define the Badge class and initializer.
Store label and color on the instance.
Return the requested formatted summary.
Create an instance and print the result.
